column1: # Rows 08-10 pin semantics the README states explicitly and a naive
# implementation gets wrong. They are not in the README's worked-examples table;

column3: leading **/ must match ZERO segments — **/*auth* has to select a repo-root auth.py, not just src/lib/auth.py

test_globs and source_exts are case-insensitive — src/Foo.TEST.TS counts as a test change (README's own example), so qa is NOT selected despite a non-trivial 10-line source change in src/Foo.TS
